source.origin: Extracted from the author's own renderer, which is not public.
source.note: This pack is data, not geometry. Nothing in the kernel requires it.

pool.liveDrawerNote: rtInitMats() uses RENDRE_MATLIB *instead of* RT_STARTER_MATS (starter is a fallback, not a concatenation), so Rendre's live drawer holds 567 of the 583 declared. The curation rule's denominators are measured against the declared pool.

curation.brief: A small subset of Rendre's library, chosen for industrial, jewellery and furniture design. No smoke/volume materials.
curation.method: category-prefix rule with per-category caps, applied to `cat` (source data). `tags` does not exist in Rendre's source.
curation.tieBreak: within a capped prefix: round-robin across the distinct `cat` values under it (first-appearance order), source order within each.

excluded.reason: smoke/volume participating media — excluded by the user. ⚠ This is where Amber and Glass, Bottle Green live: they ARE jewellery/product materials, excluded on IMPLEMENTATION grounds, not domain grounds.
Neon / Ember / Lava — light sources, not finishes
dazzle-camouflage livery — a graphic, not a finish
render trick (the see-through poster shell), not a material
sci-fi panelling — outside the three domains
weathered marine set — outside the three domains
⚠ Rendre-owned SCENE FURNITURE, not a pickable material. Excluded from the LIBRARY only — the ground plane itself still ships.
Plain Gray / Plain White — Unreason has its own default

counts.selectedFrom: live (RT_STARTER_MATS excluded — it is a shadowed fallback, not in Rendre's drawer)

fieldDefaultsNote: Applied only where the source omits a field; each value is the default the renderer's own material packer applies. Per-material `defaulted` lists which core fields came from here rather than from source.

environment.name: Rendre Studio (default)
environment.origin: The renderer's default studio dome, decoded for env slug "studio".
environment.license: Original procedural work, synthesized rather than captured. No third-party attribution required.

higherResolution.note: A higher-resolution dome exists and is not copied here. The wider library it belongs to is mostly the same original procedural work, with a few domes CC0 from Poly Haven.
